analysis: Cross-source read: this morning's tape is a risk-on continuation of yesterday's record AI rally, but the driver shifted from chips to diplomacy. The single biggest market mover is the Iran/Hormuz diplomacy bundle (Kyodo's Hormuz-reopening offer + Saudi pipeline reopening + Trump's UNGA/Iran meeting openness) — oil down >2% for a fifth straight session and the 10-year yield ticking down to 4.95% are the direct transmission lines lifting equities and cooling the VIX to a 3-week low. That is signal, not noise, though the Kyodo report is single-source and unconfirmed, so treat the Iran tailwind as fragile. What changed vs the ~6:05 AM PT pre-open brief: post-open price action is now in (Dow/S&P +0.2%, Nasdaq +0.5%), the agentic-commerce story deepened (HN's 150-pt/156-comment thread confirms the Amazon-vs-Muse blocking is the community's top tech-market story of the week, while Shopify's +7% early pop is the bull case for Muse-as-commerce-platform), and semis are now openly digesting yesterday's record (AMD and Teradyne soft). The META Muse adoption theme (2.5M+ downloads, ARK buying, Connect on Wednesday) remains the dominant company-specific narrative and is broadening into a 'which consumer product rips next' frame (Munster naming TSLA/AAPL). Fed hawkishness (Warsh hike + Musalem's 'more hikes likely') is the main counterweight, but the tape is ignoring it while oil disinflation runs. Noise to discount: Intel/Arm Monday surges are continuation moves, not new news; USAC is quiet.

community_signals.takeaway: 156 comments frame the emerging agentic-commerce battleground: Amazon walls off its store while Shopify plugs Muse into Shop Pay. Top comment threads debate (1) bot legal/compliance — approved bots with purchase limits vs runaway shopping agents, (2) AI-purchase return-rate risk vs human review, and (3) whether users will simply bypass blocks with local browser agents. The consensus read: whoever taxes AI-shopping traffic becomes the new gatekeeper — a commercial angle missing from the plain headlines.
community_signals.title: Amazon blocks Meta's new Muse AI agent from shopping on amazon.com

headlines.headline: Indexes higher just after the open: Dow +0.2%, S&P 500 +0.2%, Nasdaq +0.5%, on re-emerging US-Iran peace hopes.
headlines.why_it_matters: Risk-on breadth on diplomacy — a green start extends the rally beyond yesterday's AI-only names.

headlines.headline: WTI crude tumbled more than 2% to ~$93.60/bbl, on pace for a fifth straight down session. Reports say Saudi Arabia is looking to reopen a critical pipeline this week; Kyodo reports Iran offered to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days if the US eases military pressure.
headlines.why_it_matters: Falling energy is the market's clearest disinflation tailwind — and the direct lift behind this morning's green open.

headlines.headline: 10-year Treasury yield ticked lower to 4.95%; the VIX fell to 14.69, its lowest since Sept 3.
headlines.why_it_matters: Lower yields plus subdued volatility remove two headwinds — rate-sensitive and growth names breathe easier.

headlines.headline: AMD was an early loser Tuesday, cooling after Monday's 10% surge to $615.52 that took its market cap above $1T for the first time; Teradyne also slipped ~1%.
headlines.why_it_matters: Post-milestone digestion in the AI leaders — profit-taking is the test of whether yesterday's record surge sticks.

headlines.headline: Shopify jumped more than 7% just after the open, the top Nasdaq-100 performer, on its tie-up letting Meta's Muse AI agent complete purchases across Shopify stores via Shop Pay.
headlines.why_it_matters: Turns Muse hype into a concrete commerce use case — the first revenue-adjacent AI-shopping story for Meta's consumer push.

headlines.headline: Meta carried Muse momentum into Tuesday: the AI agent topped 2.5M downloads and briefly topped Apple's US App Store, Cathie Wood's ARK bought ~51,000 META shares Monday, and the annual Connect developer conference starts Wednesday.
headlines.why_it_matters: Consumer-AI adoption is the new bull case — Connect is the next catalyst for keeping the story moving.

headlines.headline: Apple climbed 0.4% in morning trading, moving closer to a cup-base entry at 344.57, as the iPhone 18 Pro goes on sale.
headlines.why_it_matters: The Mag 7 YTD leader (+23%) working toward a breakout keeps the index bid alive even as chips digest.

headlines.headline: Tesla edged toward a three-week high after Nvidia included Tesla energy storage in its DSX Ready AI-factory ecosystem; analyst Gene Munster said Tesla could be next to 'rip' like Meta's Muse rally on its FSD v15 / Cybercab / Optimus pipeline.

headlines.headline: Paramount Skydance settled with 12 state attorneys general and the Writers Guild, removing key legal hurdles for its $110B Warner Bros. Discovery acquisition.
headlines.why_it_matters: Deal-overhang removal — a cleared regulatory path typically re-rates the acquirer's deal math.
